title: Illumio Puts Breach Containment at the Centre of AI Resilience with WWT’s ARMOR
headline: Illumio featured in WWT's ARMOR framework for AI resilience and risk management
summary: Illumio Inc. has announced it will be included in World Wide Technology's AI Readiness Model for Operational Resilience (ARMOR), a vendor-agnostic framework for assessing and managing AI risk. The integration aims to help organisations prevent single compromises in AI environments from becoming business-wide disruptions by applying breach containment, visibility, and least privilege segmentation.
why_it_matters: The inclusion of breach containment platforms in vendor-agnostic AI risk frameworks highlights how organisations are expanding their technical controls to manage lateral movement risks in highly connected AI infrastructure.

quotes.text: Illumio Inc. , the breach containment company, today announced it will be featured in World Wide Technology’s ( WWT ) AI Readiness Model for Operational Resilience (ARMOR), a vendor-agnostic framework for assessing and managing AI risk.

With its differentiated ability to see and contain lateral movement across complex environments, Illumio contributes to ARMOR’s broader approach to helping organisations build secure, resilient AI environments.

classification.significance_reason: This is a vendor product and partnership announcement regarding a risk management framework, representing standard commercial security tooling rather than a regulatory mandate.
